{{Quote|Ventress strikes in The Fall of Falleen!|Tagline|<ref name="The Clone Wars: The Fall of Falleen">''[[The Clone Wars: The Fall of Falleen]]''</ref>}}
"'''The Clone Wars: The Fall of Falleen'''" is a seven-page [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' webcomic series]] that takes place prior to the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series episode "[[Downfall of a Droid]]." Posted on [[StarWars.com]] on [[November 7]], [[2008]], the comic was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]], illustrated by [[Tom Hodges|Thomas Hodges]], and lettered by [[Grant Gould]]. "The Fall of Falleen" depicts the actions of [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] during the final act of a [[Fall of Falleen|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]].

==Plot summary==
{{Quote|Accursed ''vandal''! I will not be denied my entertainment!|The King of Falleen|<ref name="The Clone Wars: The Fall of Falleen" />}}
[[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces are [[Fall of Falleen|occupying]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]]. [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] are deploying ground [[Troop/Legends|troops]], protected by [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|''Hyena''-class droid bombers]]. A [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] reports to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies]], that a [[City/Legends|city]] has fallen, except for one [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielded]] [[King of Falleen's fortress|fortress]]. Grievous orders the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to continue landing the troops, mentioning that the shield is being taken care of.

[[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], having infiltrated the fortress, is spotted by a [[TT-8L gatekeeper droid/Legends|TT-8L gatekeeper droid]]. On a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]], the [[Unidentified King of Falleen|King of Falleen]] notices her approach and sends his [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaff]]-wielding [[Dashade/Legends|Dashade]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] to deal with her. However, the electrostaffs are no match for Ventress, who is armed with [[Interlocking hilt|lightsabers]]. She [[Death/Legends|kills]] two of the bodyguards before using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to destroy the gatekeeper droids as well. No longer able to watch the duel, the [[King/Legends|king]] arms himself with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] and leaves his command center to confront the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] personally. As Ventress kills the last Dashade, the king prepares to shoot her with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], but he is instead ambushed by none other than [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] himself. Dooku had used Ventress as a ruse to lure the king out of his secure command center, while the elimination of the gatekeeper droids left the king oblivious of a second intruder within the fortress. Dooku orders the king to lower the fortress's shields and to submit the planet to the Separatists' cause.

==Development==
"The Clone Wars: The Fall of Falleen" is a seven-page [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' webcomic series]], which ties into the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|television series of the same name]]. Chronologically, "The Fall of Falleen" takes place prior to "[[Downfall of a Droid]]," the sixth episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the television series.<ref name="webcomic45" /> The comic was posted on [[StarWars.com]] on [[November 7]], [[2008]],<ref name="Archives" /> and was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]], illustrated by [[Tom Hodges|Thomas Hodges]], and lettered by [[Grant Gould]].<ref name="webcomic45" /> "The Fall of Falleen" depicts a battle on Falleen, which would be mentioned in both "Downfall of a Droid"<ref name="EpGuide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode006.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Downfall of a Droid}}</ref> and the novel ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'', written by [[Karen Miller]].<ref name="WildSpace">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref> It was also the first appearance of the ''Hyena''-class droid bomber, which would later appear in the television series.<ref name="Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode021.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref>
